claim: Walgreens: Can you pick up a regular refill from any store in ... - Reddit
summary: The systems are interconnected. You may use the automated system to put in the refills at the Walgreens of your choice using the RX #'s. If one of her anti-anxiety meds is a controlled medication, then you will have to speak with somebody in the pharmacy and they will have to contact her home pharmacy to transfer it.
